control.title: External security and privacy commitments
control.description: Communicate security commitments to customers and partners through terms, a trust page and contractual documents, and keep them consistent with practice.

evidence_hint: Public trust or security page, customer terms, sample security addendum.
acceptance_criteria: Public or contractual security and privacy commitments are shown (trust page, terms or addendum)

criteria_coverage.criterion: Public or contractual security and privacy commitments are shown (trust page, terms or addendum)

requirements.title: External communication
requirements.guidance: Communicate commitments and relevant matters to customers, vendors and regulators.

requirements.title: Communication
requirements.guidance: Decide what, when, with whom and how to communicate about security, internally and externally.
